I need to verify C19: The dogfood-3 findings are grounded. I need to read docs/dogfood-3.md and this run's .opencode/goals/ship-v03-feedback-loop/ledger.jsonl and evidence/ directory.

Let me start by reading those files.

The glob for `.opencode/goals/ship-v03-feedback-loop/**` returned no files. That's odd. Let me check the `.opencode` directory structure. Maybe glob doesn't include hidden dirs by default — yes, glob has `hidden` parameter default false. Let me retry with hidden: true.

The evidence directory only contains contract.json, rehearsal.json, contract.yaml — no verifier-transcript file. The doc claims §6 that "Its transcript is persisted at `.opencode/goals/ship-v03-feedback-loop/evidence/<runId>/verifier-transcript-turn-<N>-<ts>.json`" — but no such file exists in the evidence folder. Also, there's a `<!-- VERIFIER-QUOTE: filled by the completing round under the reinstalled v0.3.0 -->` placeholder comment that is NOT filled — the doc says "The quote from that round: see the evidence file referenced by the `verifier-transcript` ledger event of the completing turn" — which is a dodge rather than an actual quote. C18 said "docs/dogfood-3.md exists, quotes this run's verification evidence (verifier-transcript/goal_verdict)" — but that's a different criterion; I'm judging C19.

Wait — the worker claim says "dogfood-3 §6 quotes this completing round's transcript." Let me check the ledger to see if there is a `verifier-transcript` ledger event and a `verifier-model` event. Let me read the ledger.

The ledger ends at line 38 with a `verifier-model` event. There is no `verifier-transcript` ledger event, no `verifier-empty` event (though S1 claims "empty exchanges retried once + ledgered (verifier-empty)" — but no verifier-empty event exists in the ledger; that may be because no empty exchange happened in this round, which is fine — the ledgered verifier-empty event only occurs when an empty exchange happens).

Critically for C19:
1. The doc §6 says the verifier transcript is persisted at `.opencode/goals/ship-v03-feedback-loop/evidence/<runId>/verifier-transcript-turn-<N>-<ts>.json`. The glob shows the evidence folder contains only contract.json, rehearsal.json, contract.yaml. No verifier-transcript file exists.
2. §6 has a placeholder comment `<!-- VERIFIER-QUOTE: filled by the completing round under the reinstalled v0.3.0 -->` that is not filled — instead the text defers: "The quote from that round: see the evidence file referenced by the `verifier-transcript` ledger event of the completing turn". But there is no `verifier-transcript` ledger event in the ledger (it ends at verifier-model, line 38).
3. The worker's claim says "dogfood-3 §6 quotes this completing round's transcript" — §6 does NOT contain an actual quote; it contains a reference to a file that doesn't exist.

Wait — I should be careful. I am the verifier child being invoked right now, potentially. The claim event at line 36 is turn 4, verify-start at line 37, verifier-model at line 38. The verifier round is happening NOW (this very session might be that verifier child). So the transcript file and the verifier-transcript ledger event would be written after I complete — which means §6 cannot yet quote a completed verdict. But the criterion C19 asks: "does the doc ground its claims ... a real verifier verdict from the child on the main host ... and list defects with CLEO task ids? List anything missing or unsupported."

Hmm. The judgment I'm asked to make: does the doc ground its claims in this run's ledger/evidence, and list defects with CLEO ids.

Let me check each claim in the doc:

§1:
- Owner steer quote about dashboard: ledger line 14 has the steer event with matching text "the dashboard has not updated at all". The doc quotes: *"the dashboard has not updated at all… still shows 0 out of 22 criteria and is still stuck on S1."* — Let me check the ledger steer text: "Please note that for all the work you have been doing, the dashboard has not updated at all. I do not know if that is part of your next work in S10, but I wanted to give you a heads-up that nothing in the dashboard is updating or tracking your progress. \n\nAs you have been working". Hmm — the doc's quote includes "still shows 0 out of 22 criteria and is still stuck on S1" which is NOT in the ledger steer text. The steer text in the ledger does not contain "0 out of 22" or "stuck on S1". So that portion of the quote is unsupported by the ledger. Hmm, but maybe the steer came through a different channel (the owner's message) and the ledger may have truncated. The ledger's steer text ends with "As you have been working" — looks truncated mid-sentence. The doc's quoted ellipsis suggests more text. It's plausible the ledger truncated the steer text. Can't fully verify "0 out of 22 criteria... stuck on S1" from the ledger. Partially supported.

- Root cause: "the engine *did* emit `updated` on every persist" — hmm, interesting. The ledger S10 note at line 16 says "the engine emits `updated` from only ~7 call sites; the TUI fetches one snapshot per session and then relies on those events — so the card freezes at its first render. Fix = emit on persist + re-fetch triggers." And line 17 says "TUI defensively re-fetches stale snapshots (renders + 4s live-goal ticker) so a dropped event stream can't freeze the card; engine events verified flowing on every persist." So the doc's story matches the ledger roughly: engine did emit updated on persist (verified event flow), TUI trusted single subscription. O

Now I have the full picture:

- run.json status: "verifying", activity kind "verifier-child", detail "zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3#high" — that's me, right now. The run is in the middle of its verifying round.
- The ledger's last event is `verifier-model` (line 38). No verdict event yet, no `verifier-transcript` event, no transcript file in evidence/.
- §6 of dogfood-3.md contains an unfilled placeholder `<!-- VERIFIER-QUOTE: filled by the completing round under the reinstalled v0.3.0 -->` and points to a `verifier-transcript` ledger event that does not exist in ledger.jsonl.

So for C19: "does the doc ground its claims (... a real verifier verdict from the child on the main host ...) and list defects with CLEO task ids?"

Assessment of grounding:
1. Dialog/notice/tracer behaviour (§2 table): grounded in ledger progress events (lines 5-20), which name each commit, and in the passed host/unit checks (C6, C7, C8, etc.). ✔
2. The reinstall gate (§5): grounded in ledger block events (lines 22, 27, 30), blocked (32), resumed by owner (33), and S13 gate passed (35). ✔
3. A real verifier verdict from the child on the main host (§6): NOT grounded. The evidence folder has no verifier transcript; the ledger has no verifier verdict or verifier-transcript event; §6's quote is an unfilled HTML placeholder. The doc's own text says "filled by the completing round" — i.e., it is pending, not present. The worker's claim "dogfood-3 §6 quotes this completing round's transcript" is contradicted by the doc content: §6 does not quote the transcript; it defers to a file/event that doesn't exist yet.
4. Amendment or approval events: amendments is [] in run.json — doc doesn't claim amendments, fine. Approvals: decisions.jsonl has owner decisions, and the resumed-by-owner event. Doc doesn't specifically claim approval events, so fine.
5. Defects with CLEO ids (§3): T058 filed/fixed — grounded (ledger S10 events, line 16-17, plus doc "Fixed as T058 (d0f1183)"). T024 open with T059-T061 — grounded in ledger lines 21/23 and decisions.jsonl line 6. The "cleo#1832-adjacent environment note" claims a CLEO observation was recorded — not traceable to the run's ledger/evidence (minor, and doc itself marks it "observed, not filed as plugin defect").
6. §1's steer quote: partially — ledger steer (line 14) contains "the dashboard has not updated at all" but NOT "still shows 0 out of 22 criteria and is still stuck on S1". The ledger text appears truncated ("As you have been working"). The doc's fuller quote cannot be verified from the ledger. Minor unsupported fragment.

So the decisive question: is C19 proven? The criterion's question explicitly asks about "a real verifier verdict from the child on the main host" as one of the things to check for grounding. At verification time (now, which is that verifier round itself), there is no recorded verdict — the round is in flight. §6 is explicitly a placeholder. The doc cannot ground a verdict that hasn't happened yet; the doc is honest about it ("filled by the completing round") but the claim says "dogfood-3 §6 quotes this completing round's transcript" — which is currently false: §6 does not quote anything, it points to a not-yet-existing artifact.

Fail closed: C19 is not_proven. Most of the doc is well grounded (ledger citations check out almost line-by-line), and defects carry CLEO ids — but the centerpiece §6 verifier-verdict evidence is absent: no verifier-transcript ledger event, no evidence file, unfilled quote placeholder. Also minor: the §1 steer quote includes text ("0 out of 22 criteria... stuck on S1") not present in the ledger's steer record.

Is it "contradicted" rather than "not_proven"? The criterion says findings grounded: every claim traceable + defects filed. Some claims are not traceable (the §6 quote, part of the steer quote). The doc itself flags §6 as pending. The worker claim asserts §6 quotes the transcript — contradicted by the doc's own placeholder. I'd say "not_proven" is the right verdict since

Confirmed: no verifier-transcript file exists anywhere in the repo; the evidence folder contains only contract/rehearsal artifacts with no verdict data. The ledger ends at the `verifier-model` event (this round, in flight). run.json status is "verifying".

- §1 root cause + T058 (d0f1183): ledger lines 14–17 ✔
- §1/§5 reinstall gate: ledger lines 22, 27, 30, 32, 33, 35 ✔

Not grounded:

No verdict from the verifier child is recorded anywhere. The worker claim "dogfood-3 §6 quotes this completing round's transcript" is contradicted by the doc's own content.
- §1's steer quote includes "still shows 0 out of 22 criteria and is still stuck on S1", which does not appear in the ledger's steer record (line 14 text differs and appears truncated).

Verdict: not_proven. The criterion demands a real verifier verdict grounding among other things; that artifact is absent at verification time, and one quoted fragment is unverifiable. Much of the doc IS grounded, but fail closed on the missing centerpiece.

I have everything needed. Summary of my inspection for C19:

**Grounded (verified against ledger/evidence):**
- §2 step/commit table: every row matches a `progress` ledger event naming the same commit (S1 c36ef35 … S13 604b756); "two `recovered` + one `steer`" matches ledger lines 10/13/14.
- §5 reinstall gate: `block` ×3 (owner-reinstall-v030), `blocked`, `resumed by owner`, and "install cache pins #v0.3.0" all present in the ledger.

**Not grounded / missing:**

It points to a `verifier-transcript` ledger event that **does not exist** (ledger ends at the `verifier-model` event; run.json status is `verifying`) and to an evidence file `verifier-transcript-turn-<N>-<ts>.json` that **does not exist** — `evidence/109159956001/` holds only contract.json, contract.yaml, rehearsal.json, and a repo-wide glob finds no `verifier-transcript*` file. Failing closed: the criterion names the verifier-verdict grounding explicitly, and that artifact is absent.

Verdict recorded for C19: **not_proven** — the dogfood-3 doc grounds its step/commit table, reinstall gate, and defect ids (T058, T024/T059–T061) in the run's ledger, but §6's verifier-verdict evidence is still a placeholder with no corresponding ledger event or evidence file, and one steer-quote fragment is unverifiable from the ledger.
